text:
{collection}.{field}: target {target} removed.
Existing links into {target} would read as wrong collection, and references into it as missing, on upgraded clients only.
Keep {target} in the targets.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a collection is removed from the targets of a link or a reference.
